description: This Python source file provides utility functions for parsing JSON and YAML configuration files, including functions to load configs, parse simple YAML, and generate default config templates. It defines a default configuration dictionary, a function to interpret 'heads' input strings, and a main function to load configs from files with fallback parsing.

methods.name: heads_input_type
methods.description: Converts a string in the format 'Hq,Hkv' to a tuple of integers (Hq, Hkv).

methods.name: load_config_file
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a JSON or YAML file, automatically converting 'nh' fields from strings to tuples.

methods.name: _parse_simple_yaml
methods.description: Parses a simple YAML string into a dictionary, supporting key-value pairs, lists, booleans, nulls, and comments.

methods.name: print_default_config
methods.description: Outputs a default configuration template in JSON or YAML format.
